capabilities.name: Prove who you are with a national digital ID
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent use a national digital ID or data wallet to prove who a person is to a private app?

US.note: There is no national ID, so it counts as limited. Login.gov serves only government agencies. Businesses can check state mobile driver's licenses in Google Wallet through the Digital Credentials API, but these are state IDs, not a national one.

evidence.title: Login.gov is now accepting mobile driver's licenses
Accepted ID types: mobile driver's licenses in a digital wallet
Verify with Google Wallet digital IDs
Login.gov roadmap, August 2026

GB.note: GOV.UK One Login serves central government only, and GOV.UK Wallet holds just the veteran card. Since 1 September 2026 certified digital verification services (DVS) can test checks of a sample driving license in a GOV.UK Wallet sandbox, but it is not a production service, so it counts as announced. Private firms can use certified DVS providers (46 providers and 64 services on the statutory register in July 2026). The new government cancelled the national digital ID scheme in July 2026.

evidence.title: How to access the GOV.UK Wallet sandbox
Using GOV.UK Wallet in the digital identity sector
GOV.UK Wallet - Roadmap for modern digital government
Digital Verification Services 2026 Annual Report on the operation of Part 2 of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025
Digital ID in the UK

DE.note: Any company can accept the Online-Ausweis (eID) after it gets a state authorization certificate or uses a certified eID service; the EUDI wallet 'd-you' is due on 2 January 2027.

evidence.title: Diensteanbieter werden
eID-Service
EUDI-Wallet

BR.note: SERPRO's Datavalid API lets approved firms check a person's face, liveness, registration data and CNH QR code against official records; the gov.br login itself is open mainly to public bodies.

evidence.title: Nova versão do Datavalid amplia modalidades de validação
Datavalid API Docs
Autenticação Digital (Login Único) - Catálogo de APIs

MX.note: Banks and other firms that sign an agreement with INE check the voter credential, the de facto national ID, through INE's data verification service set up in 2016, and vendors such as Veridas also match the person's face against the INE photo. As in Colombia, ordinary firms can get access, so it counts as live. The Llave MX rules require federal platforms to use it for sign-in but set no access for private apps, and the biometric CURP is not yet open to private apps.

evidence.title: Acuerdo INE/CG92/2016: Servicio de Verificación de los Datos de la Credencial para Votar
INE-Check & RENAPO - General Information
Ni con datos biométricos la CURP desplaza al INE
Lineamientos para la implementación y operación de Llave MX
Identification for Development (ID4D) Global Dataset

CL.note: ClaveÚnica is open only to private bodies that a law or rule expressly allows, such as pension funds (AFP) and e-signature providers, under terms approved in October 2025 (Resolución Exenta 733/2025). Unlike in Mexico and Colombia, an ordinary firm cannot sign up, so it counts as limited.

evidence.title: Resolución Exenta 733/2025: aprueba términos y condiciones para la integración y uso de ClaveÚnica
evidence.publisher: Ministerio de Hacienda, Secretaría de Gobierno Digital

evidence.title: Términos y condiciones ClaveÚnica
Gobierno Digital entrega recomendaciones para un correcto uso de ClaveÚnica

CO.note: Banks and other firms check identity against the Registraduría's biometric database through certified operators (fingerprint, and face at level 2), with 2026 tariffs set by Resolución 1500 of 2026. Banks can also check a face in real time against Registraduría records with the Cédula Digital PIN, a face match or both. Any firm can use a certified operator, so it counts as live. Carpeta Ciudadana stays a public-sector service.

evidence.title: Resolución Registraduría 13691 de 2016 (aliados tecnológicos)
Resolución 1500 de 2026 (RNEC): tarifas de acceso a las bases de datos de identificación y autenticación biométrica
evidence.publisher: Registraduría Nacional del Estado Civil (compilación Cancillería)

evidence.title: BBVA, primer banco en implementar la verificación biométrica en Colombia
Registraduría Nacional pone a disposición del sector financiero tecnología
Identification for Development (ID4D) Global Dataset

IN.note: Aadhaar eKYC and face authentication are open to approved private entities (417 KUAs and about 26 billion eKYC transactions on UIDAI's dashboard), and DigiLocker lets registered firms pull documents with user consent.

evidence.title: eKYC Dashboard
SOP for submission of applications by private entities
Government launches Aadhaar Good Governance portal to streamline approval process for Aadhaar authentication requests
The design of digital financial infrastructure: lessons from India (BIS Papers No 106)
Identification for Development (ID4D) Global Dataset
E-Government Survey 2024, Chapter 1 (Box 1.5: Aadhaar in India)

ES.note: A qualified signature with the electronic DNI's chip certificates is a legal way to prove who you are remotely, and the national mint (FNMT) validates those certificates for companies as well as government; identity services such as Didit also read the chip by NFC. Since 2 April 2026 public and private bodies must also accept the MiDNI phone app for in-person checks, but MiDNI does not yet support online sign-in or signatures, and the EU digital identity wallet is not yet live.

evidence.title: DNIe NFC verification in Spain
Spain's MiDNI Mobile App Now Legally Valid for In-Person Identification
Nuevo deber de identificación: aceptar el DNI móvil en trámites presenciales públicos y privados

FR.note: FranceConnect+ lets private firms check identity with France Identité (high level) or L'Identité Numérique La Poste (substantial), but only firms that a law requires to verify identity, such as banks, may connect, after a DataPass request. France Identité had over 5 million users in October 2026; no open API serves other apps or agents.

evidence.title: Conditions générales d'utilisation FranceConnect pour les fournisseurs de services (v3.9)
Intégration FranceConnect+ (eligibility of private companies, identity providers)

CA.note: Canada has no national digital ID. British Columbia's Person credential in BC Wallet is accepted only by select pilots, and the province says private-sector use may come later; Quebec passed its digital identity law in October 2025 with a wallet planned by 2028. We found no provincial ID that private apps can check today.

evidence.title: Person credential for BC Wallet
Quebec Passes Landmark Digital ID Law Emphasizing Privacy and User Control

JP.note: Private companies can check identity with the My Number card's public certificates (JPKI) once a minister certifies them or through a certified platform provider, and banks and brokers use it to open accounts. The certificates also work from a smartphone. We found no agent that uses JPKI for a person, but the rail is open to private apps.

evidence.title: 民間事業者に対して公的個人認証サービスの利用に関する主務大臣認定を行いました
「スマホ用電子証明書搭載サービス」スタート

AU.note: The Digital ID Act 2024 set up the Australian Government Digital ID System, but myID serves government services today. Private sector participation starts on 1 December 2026, so the cell is announced.

evidence.title: Digital ID expands to the private sector
Digital ID expands to the private sector

NG.note: NIMC's NINAuth, launched in May 2025, offers web, API and mobile checks of the National Identification Number with the holder's explicit consent, including for KYC and financial transactions, and is NIMC's sole channel for NIN verification; private firms reach it through licensed partners. The NIMC Act 2026, signed in June 2026, backs the system.

evidence.title: Nigeria unveils platform to streamline national ID authentication, verification
NINAuth - Nigeria Digital ID Authentication
NIMC Act 2026: turning Nigeria's identity system into an economic asset

KR.note: South Korea's national mobile ID is open to six private apps: Samsung, Naver, Toss, KB Kookmin Bank, NH Nonghyup Bank and KakaoBank. Eighteen banks link it for remote services, mainly account opening. No source found says an AI agent can present it on your behalf.

evidence.title: Financial Security Institute expands mobile ID use in finance
evidence.publisher: Byline Network (reporting the Financial Security Institute)

SG.note: Singpass is Singapore's national digital ID, and private firms can use it: it serves over 1,400 government agencies and participating private organisations, and more than 1,800 digital services use Myinfo to pre-fill forms. The person still has to approve each login with a face scan, fingerprint or passcode in the Singpass app.

evidence.title: Singpass: Singapore's national digital identity (Annex D factsheet)

ID.note: Indonesia's national digital ID app, IKD, lets people prove who they are at some private firms. OCBC has let new customers open accounts with it at every branch since February 2025, and secondary reports say BNI and Bank DKI use it for mobile banking, but we could not open those reports. We found no AI agent that can use IKD for you, and access beyond a few banks is unclear, so the status is limited.

evidence.title: OCBC press release: opening an account with the IKD app

IT.note: SPID, Italy's national digital ID, can be used by private services that choose to accept it. The person must log in with their own SPID, so an agent can help but cannot prove who the person is on its own. We could not confirm how private apps check identity through the IT Wallet in the IO app.

evidence.title: SPID home page (become a service provider section)

NL.note: The NL Wallet is not live: the government says it needs national implementing law first, with consultation expected at the end of 2026. Private apps can already check identity through iDIN, a bank-based service that itsme has taken over, but the person identifies through their bank and we found no AI agent that uses it.

evidence.title: Digital identity wallet (NL Wallet)
Online identificeren via uw bank (iDIN)

capabilities.name: Finish a public-service task with a government assistant
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent use a government AI assistant to finish a public-service task, not just get answers?

US.note: The IRS voice bot lets taxpayers who prove who they are set up and manage payment plans and make payments (deployed in June 2022; the Treasury inspector general's June 2026 report describes it but tested only chat); IRS web chatbots use set answers, not generative AI, and most state chatbots only answer questions.

evidence.title: Using voice and chat bots to improve the collection taxpayer experience
Privacy Impact Assessment: Taxpayer Services chatbot
Opportunities Exist to Improve the Quality of Chat Applications (Report 2026-308-029)
evidence.publisher: Treasury Inspector General for Tax Administration (TIGTA)

evidence.title: NASCIO Agentic AI Report 2026

GB.note: GOV.UK Chat in the GOV.UK app answers questions from GOV.UK guidance but does not complete tasks; an agent pilot for 16 to 24 year olds is testing next steps, and agentic features are planned from March 2027.

evidence.title: GOV.UK app - Roadmap for modern digital government
AI chatbot fully integrated into GOV.UK app
Anthropic partners with the UK Government to bring AI assistance to GOV.UK services

DE.note: Some cities run chatbots that only answer questions, such as Stuttgart's AI chatbot, in trial since March 2025. Bremen's KOMPASS assistant, which will help people find services and prepare applications, is due step by step from late 2026.

evidence.title: Chatbot der Stadt Stuttgart
KI-Assistent für das Serviceportal Bremen

BR.note: Chat GOV.BR, the government's AI chatbot, answers Enem and Sisu questions from links in GOV.BR inbox and WhatsApp messages, and other government chatbots answer questions on vaccines and Farmácia Popular. None of them completes a transaction.

evidence.title: Governo do Brasil orienta estudantes sobre resultado do Enem pela Caixa Postal GOV.BR
Ministério da Gestão e CPQD fazem balanço de primeiras ações de IA do projeto INSPIRE
evidence.publisher: Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação

evidence.title: MGI aposta em IA para transformar serviços públicos e fortalecer a soberania digital
evidence.publisher: Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação

MX.note: Ventanilla 24/7, the AI assistant on gob.mx and WhatsApp, has been live since January 2026 and helps people find and follow up trámites, but the government plans to let it finish trámites only by 2030.

evidence.title: Ventanilla 24/7, el canal de contacto del Gobierno de México con la ciudadanía, supera un millón de atenciones
evidence.publisher: Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT)

evidence.title: Agenda 2030: Inteligencia artificial
evidence.publisher: Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT)

CL.note: ChileAtiende's generative AI assistant only gives general guidance on trámites and cannot see a person's records or file anything.

evidence.title: Términos y condiciones de uso

CO.note: Robi, the assistant on the GOV.CO portal, guides people on trámites around the clock, and MinTIC announced AI chatbots for requests and complaints in July 2026; neither completes tasks.

evidence.title: Ministerio TIC lanza Robi y GOV.CO 2.0
MinTIC transforma la gestión pública con seis modelos de Inteligencia Artificial para optimizar servicios y procesos institucionales

IN.note: UIDAI's Udai chatbot (Hindi and English) checks Aadhaar update status and files grievances, and Kisan e-Mitra (built on Bhashini, 11 languages) answers PM-KISAN questions and handles grievances.

evidence.title: CRM Division (Udai chatbot)
Kisan e-Mitra AI chatbot
evidence.publisher: PIB, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

evidence.title: Empowering millions of Indian farmers with instant AI chatbot support

ES.note: The Tax Agency (AEAT) runs virtual assistants for income tax, VAT and the SII invoice system that answer questions and help fill in forms such as VAT model 303; none files or completes the task for you, and we found no national generative AI assistant that does. The Comunidad de Madrid tested AI assistants with local information in 33 towns in December 2025.

evidence.title: Los asistentes virtuales que la AEAT utiliza para gestionar el SII y el IVA
La Comunidad de Madrid prueba en 33 municipios asistentes virtuales con inteligencia artificial que ofrecen información local a los vecinos

FR.note: France's state AI tools serve civil servants, not the public: the Assistant IA (Albert) was opened to all state agents in June 2026, and the Albert pilot in France Services offices was not extended in its current form, with opening it to users 'not considered at this stage'. A generative tool for the 3939 and service-public.gouv.fr advisers (ARIA) is being tested. No citizen-facing assistant that finishes a task was found.

evidence.title: Albert, l'outil d'IA générative, expérimenté à France Services ne sera pas généralisé
L'État généralise son assistant IA à tous les agents dans une version améliorée

CA.note: The Canada Revenue Agency's generative AI virtual assistant (launched March 2025, updated May 2026) helps people find CRA information from Canada.ca but does not complete tasks; the CRA plans to add it to the secure CRA Account. No federal or provincial AI assistant that finishes a public-service task was found.

evidence.title: Canada Revenue Agency virtual assistant consultation

JP.note: City chatbots answer questions but do not finish tasks: Matsudo's generative AI guide chatbot started on 12 June 2026 and answers from the city's website. The Ministry of Internal Affairs set up a study group in 2026 on AI agents for short-staffed local governments, with a final report due around summer 2027, and Osaka City's trial with Hitachi on commuting-allowance forms is staff-side.

evidence.title: 「生成AI総合案内チャットボット」が稼働します
Japan Weighing AI Agents for Understaffed Local Govts

AU.note: Services Australia's myGov digital assistant Charles and other web assistants answer common questions, but none completes a task for you. We found no generative or agentic government assistant in 2026.

evidence.title: myGov digital assistant 'Charles' is up and running

NG.note: GovGuide Nigeria, launched in May 2026 by the digital economy ministry with Meta, NCAIR and Publica AI, answers questions about more than 35 ministries on WhatsApp and the web in English, Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba, but it does not complete applications or payments.

evidence.title: FG launches AI-powered GovGuideNigeria to reach citizens via WhatsApp

KR.note: AI정부24, run by the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, answers questions and recommends public services in everyday language. Issuing documents through chat, such as a resident registration copy, is planned for late 2026, so for now you finish the task yourself.

evidence.title: AI Gov24 usage results and year-end plans (press release)
evidence.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Safety (via Korea.kr)

evidence.title: AI Gov24 trial reaches 28.5 million users

SG.note: The OneService Chatbot, on WhatsApp and Telegram, lets residents report municipal issues such as neighbourhood cleanliness and facility breakdowns in chat, and it routes each case to the right agency. GovTech's AI services page describes no citizen tool that completes a payment or booking, so the scope is narrow.

evidence.title: How GovTech uses AI to enhance digital public services

ID.note: In July 2026 Komdigi, the communications and digital ministry, said it wants AI to improve public services, but its statement names no AI service that is running. We found no government AI assistant that finishes a task for citizens. Chatbots that only answer questions may exist in some agencies, but we could not confirm one on an official page.

evidence.title: Komdigi press release on new officials and digital public services

IT.note: INPS, Italy's social security agency, announced its Arianna assistant on 27 October 2026. Arianna answers questions about more than 400 INPS benefits and guides people through the services. Help filling in applications is only planned, so Arianna does not finish a task yet.

evidence.title: Arianna, il nuovo assistente digitale basato sull'AI

NL.note: We found no Dutch government AI assistant that finishes a public-service task. The Belastingdienst (tax) website shows only search and help links, with no chatbot, and we did not check municipal or other government assistants.

evidence.title: Belastingdienst (tax authority) website

repos.name: Keycloak
repos.role: Identity server that many governments run as their login broker; an agent can sign a person in and get tokens through standard OpenID Connect.

repos.name: MOSIP eSignet
repos.role: OpenID Connect login on top of a national ID built with MOSIP, so an app can check who a person is with their national ID.

repos.name: AusweisApp
repos.role: Germany's official eID app and SDK; it lets an app read and prove a person's identity from the German ID card.

repos.name: Login.gov
repos.role: The code behind Login.gov, the US government sign-in and identity check that agencies plug into with OpenID Connect or SAML.

repos.name: GOV.UK One Login
repos.role: Sign-in backend for GOV.UK One Login, the UK government account that services use to know who a person is.

repos.name: EU Digital Identity Wallet
repos.role: Reference Android wallet for the EU Digital Identity Wallet; it holds ID credentials and shares them with apps over OpenID4VP.

repos.name: ACA-Py
repos.role: Server agent that issues, holds and checks verifiable credentials, used by governments to run digital ID and credential services.

repos.name: X-Road
repos.role: Secure data exchange layer that lets government systems (first in Estonia and Finland) ask each other for a person's data on their behalf.

repos.name: GOV.UK Chat
repos.role: The UK government AI assistant that answers questions from GOV.UK content and points people to the right service.

repos.name: DIGIT
repos.role: Platform behind Indian state and city services such as complaints, property tax and licences; its APIs let software file and track a service request.

repos.name: Sunbird RC
repos.role: Electronic registries and verifiable credentials, so apps can issue and check signed records such as certificates. A Digital Public Good.

repos.name: CREDEBL
repos.role: Decentralised identity platform that issues and verifies verifiable credentials through open-standard wallets and agents. A Digital Public Good.

repos.name: Autofirma (Cliente @firma)
repos.role: The Spanish government's official signing app, which lets a person prove who they are and sign with their DNIe national ID card or official certificate on public and private websites in Spain.

repos.name: jmulticard
repos.role: Spanish government Java library that reads smart cards such as the DNIe national ID card, so an app can check a person's identity and sign with the card in Spain.

repos.name: FranceConnect
repos.role: Source code of FranceConnect, the French state's login service, so an app can sign a person in with their tax, health or postal account through OpenID Connect.

repos.name: data.gouv.fr MCP Server
repos.role: Official MCP server from data.gouv.fr that lets an agent search, read and analyze datasets from France's national open data platform.

repos.name: OpenGateLLM (Albert API)
repos.role: Open-source AI gateway from the French state's Etalab team that runs the Albert API, the model and search service French public agencies build their assistants on.

repos.name: BC Wallet
repos.role: The Government of British Columbia's official wallet app, which holds verifiable credentials such as the BC Person Credential so a person in Canada can prove who they are to an app.

repos.name: VC-AuthN OIDC
repos.role: OpenID Connect login provider, first built by the BC Government, that lets an app sign a person in with a credential from a wallet such as BC Wallet.

repos.name: Traction
repos.role: BC Government's API-first service on top of ACA-Py that lets an organization issue and verify digital credentials in British Columbia's digital trust network.

repos.name: Jグランツ MCP Server
repos.role: MCP server from Japan's Digital Agency that lets an agent search Jグランツ, the national subsidy application system, and fetch each subsidy's details and forms.

repos.name: myna
repos.role: Command-line tool and library that reads Japan's My Number Card and signs with its JPKI public certificate, the national digital ID.

repos.name: Smile ID Node library
repos.role: Official Node.js client for Smile ID, to check a person's identity against Nigerian government ID records such as the NIN and BVN.
